baseline.name: Tensor Parallelism + Pipeline Parallelism
baseline.description: Standard baseline using TP=8 and PP=2 on 16 GPUs

tensor_parallelism.implementation: Split weight matrices across 8 devices along hidden dimension

pipeline_parallelism.implementation: Split 2 layers across 2 pipeline stages, each stage on 8 GPUs

communication_pattern.intra_stage: All-reduce across 8 GPUs within each tensor parallel group
communication_pattern.inter_stage: Pipeline communication between stage 0 and stage 1

proposed.name: Two-Level Attention Partitioning
proposed.description: Novel partitioning with m×n=16 partitions on 16 GPUs

level_1.name: head_group_partitioning
level_1.implementation: Split 16 heads into 4 groups of 4 heads each

level_2.name: dimension_partitioning
level_2.implementation: Split each head's 512 dimensions into 4 slices of 128 dimensions

computation_flow.step_1: Each GPU computes Q, K, V projections for its assigned head group and dimension slice
computation_flow.step_2: Each GPU computes attention for 4 heads × 128 dimensions = 512 total dimensions
computation_flow.step_3: Intra-group concatenation: GPUs 0-3 concatenate dimension slices for head group 0
computation_flow.step_4: Intra-group concatenation: GPUs 4-7 concatenate dimension slices for head group 1
computation_flow.step_5: Intra-group concatenation: GPUs 8-11 concatenate dimension slices for head group 2
computation_flow.step_6: Intra-group concatenation: GPUs 12-15 concatenate dimension slices for head group 3
computation_flow.step_7: Final concatenation: Concatenate outputs from 4 head groups to form complete attention output

communication_pattern.input_distribution: Broadcast input tensor X to all 16 GPUs
communication_pattern.intra_group_concatenation: All-gather within each head group (4 GPUs per group)
communication_pattern.final_concatenation: Concatenate head group outputs across all 16 GPUs
communication_pattern.communication_cost: Reduced compared to baseline due to localized partitioning

memory_distribution.memory_efficiency: Each GPU stores minimal subset of parameters and activations

implementation_notes.framework_integration: Compatible with existing model parallel frameworks
implementation_notes.gradient_synchronization: Adapt gradient synchronization for training mode
implementation_notes.hardware_topology: Optimal for 16 GPU configuration with high bandwidth interconnect
implementation_notes.scalability: Flexible m and n values based on available devices
